method: Categorical soft index master (w4-world catsoft, as w7-stage7 hulls): for every native index the one-hot mask is upsampled texel-centred (bilinear), gaussian smoothed (sigma 0.30 texel), raised to power 4 and normalised; top-3 labels and u8 weights per 2048 px. Render per CLUT: RGB = weighted mix of the visible labels; class = class of the strongest visible label where the visible weight >= 0.5. Plateaus keep the exact native colours; stair steps become smooth contours. The native class is then forced at the 2x2 px straddling every texel centre (0 forced pixels expected: the strongest label equals the native index there for every CLUT).
export_rule: keys exported only where the CLUT comes from the texture's own set CLUT block (4/6 for set A, 4/10 for set B), is not all-zero / all-black and does not show a coloured page background; every other CLUT renders from the master
